It surfaced on the Okinawa/Kadena query. The vanity path cadence.org/Thoren appears inside the PDF but the canonical /missionary/ slug never appeared in any result.
needs_review.recommendation: Do not emit on a newsletter PDF. One targeted search for 'cadence.org/missionary thoren' or a fetch of cadence.org/Thoren should resolve the canonical page and their current base.

needs_review.issue: Named ministry locations whose staff are not indexed by name
needs_review.finding: The Haven Hospitality House at North Pole (between Fort Wainwright and Eielson AFB, opened January 2025) and The Homestead Hospitality House (17607 Almdale Ave, Eagle River AK, serving JBER)
needs_review.evidence: https://cadence.org/ministry/the-haven-hospitality-house-at-north-pole/ and https://cadence.org/ministry/the-homestead-hospitality-house/ both surfaced, but no search returned a director name for either
needs_review.recommendation: These are the two clearest known gaps in the Alaska slice. Both ministry pages almost certainly name their directors in body text — high-value targets for the first fetch-enabled pass.

needs_review.issue: Guam appears to have no Cadence presence
needs_review.finding: No Guam or Andersen AFB ministry or missionary surfaced
needs_review.evidence: A dedicated Guam/Andersen query returned only org-level pages (directory, 'What We Do', 'Foreign Military Ministry')
needs_review.recommendation: Treat Guam as out of scope for Cadence in future waves rather than re-buying the query.

needs_review.issue: Base names that produced nothing and should not be re-bought individually
needs_review.finding: Iwakuni, Sasebo, Atsugi, Camp Zama, Camp Schwab, Camp Courtney, Camp Casey, Camp Carroll, Yongsan, Schofield Barracks
needs_review.evidence: Each was included in a grouped query; none returned a missionary page tied to that base
needs_review.recommendation: On this domain the ministry-name axis (Lighthouse, The Harbor, Wired Bean, Hansen Christian Center, Home Port, The Haven, The Homestead, Humphreys Hospitality House) outperforms the base-name axis. Rotate house names, not base names, in the next Pacific pass.
